archetypes.name: White-Blue Metalcraft
archetypes.plan: Build around Chrome Steed: Assemble three artifacts while controlling combat, then exploit metalcraft bonuses on evasive or defensive creatures.

archetypes.name: Blue-Black Proliferate
archetypes.plan: Build around Thrummingbird: Seed poison or charge counters early, then proliferate repeatedly while removal slows opposing pressure.

archetypes.name: Black-Green Infect
archetypes.plan: Build around Cystbearer: Apply poison with efficient infect creatures and use removal or combat tricks to force the last counters through.

archetypes.name: Red-White Metalcraft
archetypes.plan: Build around Myrsmith: Reach three artifacts quickly, switch on metalcraft bonuses, and leverage equipment or tokens in aggressive combat.

archetypes.name: Red-Green Dinosaurs
archetypes.plan: Build around Molder Beast: Accelerate with mana Myr, sacrifice expendable artifacts to enlarge the Beast, and use trample to force damage through.
